Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_id VARCHAR2(10);
 chp_sysdate DATE;
begin
 -- IM:5412; AV; 05/08/2011
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 
 -- 
 if :ctrl_blk_1.customer_id is not null
 then
 begin
 select customer_id into temp_id
 from customers
 where customer_id = :ctrl_blk_1.customer_id
 and customer_type != 'PA'
 and chapter_id = :g_chapter_id
 and chp_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,chp_sysdate+1)
 and exists
 (select 'x' from orders
 where customer_id = customers.customer_id
 and chapter_id = :g_chapter_id);
 exception
 when no_data_found
 then
 begin
 select customer_id into temp_id
 from customers
 where upper(name) like :ctrl_blk_1.customer_id || '%'
 and customer_type != 'PA'
 and chapter_id = :g_chapter_id
 and chp_sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,chp_sysdate+1)
 and exists
 (select 'x' from orders
 where customer_id = customers.customer_id
 and chapter_id = :g_chapter_id);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error_dist('0302'); -- invalid customer
 check_package_failure;
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS
 then
 list_values;
 return;
 end;
 end;
 :ctrl_blk_1.customer_id := temp_id;
 end if;
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 go_query('open_orders');
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 tackle_error('Customers, Contracts');
 check_package_failure;
end;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare 
 temp_hours NUMBER;
 temp_minutes NUMBER;
 temp1 NUMBER;
 chp_sysdate DATE;
begin
 -- IM:5412; AV; 05/08/2011
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 
 -- 
-- insert the name of the customer in the open orders block
 begin
 select name
 into :open_orders.s_customer_name
 from customers
 where customer_id = :open_orders.customer_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and chp_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,chp_sysdate+365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error_dist('0302'); -- invalid customer id
 check_package_failure;
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
-- insert the record number in orders block
 begin
 :open_orders.s_item_no := :system.trigger_record;
 end;
 -- insert class description (priority)
 begin
 select class_desc into :open_orders.s_order_class_desc
 from vserv_order_classes
 where order_class = :open_orders.order_class
 and chp_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,chp_sysdate+1)
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id; /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error_dist('0325'); -- invalid order class
 check_package_failure;
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
-- compute # of hours this order has been open
 begin
 temp1 := ((chp_sysdate - :open_orders.insert_date) * 24);
 temp_minutes := round(mod(temp1,1)*60);
 temp_hours := round(temp1);
 :open_orders.ordered_hours :=
 (to_char(temp_hours) || ':' || to_char(temp_minutes));
 end;
end;
